Market today: Inflation worries are back, potentially pressuring growth stocks. Meanwhile, the AI narrative is mixed, with China's perceived lead and US regulatory talks. This creates a cautious environment for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.75%) and SPAL (-59.5%) are leveraged and deeply in the red, flagged "SELL" and "NEW" respectively. These need immediate attention. QQQ (-2.09%), SMH (-14.46%), and QQQI (-4.6%) are also flagged "TRIM." Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and Fed commentary. Also, monitor developments in the AI space, particularly any US policy shifts.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged and "SELL/TRIM" positions, especially with inflation concerns looming.
plays: SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are down significantly. Review their stops (currently above price) and consider trimming or exiting to reduce extreme risk exposure.
QQQ, SMH, QQQI: These are flagged "TRIM." Respect their stated stops (670, 540, 52 respectively) or consider reducing position size to lower overall tech exposure given market uncertainty.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
